sample_notice: Illustrative sample audit report based on an enterprise SaaS website profile. Useful for product demonstration and test review.

health_score.calculation_formula: Score = 100 - (Normalized Penalty / Pages^0.65). Weighted deductions: Critical = -25pts, High = -15pts, Medium = -8pts, Low = -3pts. Evaluated across 12 page(s).

issues.title: Missing or Empty Title Tag
issues.evidence: <title> tag is missing or empty in HTML <head>.
issues.impact: The title tag is one of the highest-weight on-page ranking factors. Without it, search engines generate random snippet titles.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a unique, descriptive <title> tag between 50-60 characters summarizing the page topic.

issues.title: Multiple Canonical Tags Detected
issues.impact: Conflicting canonical URLs cause search engines to ignore all canonical declarations on the page, leading to duplicate indexing.
issues.suggested_fix: Ensure only one canonical tag is generated in the <head>.

issues.title: Insecure Mixed Content Detected
issues.evidence: Found 2 resource(s) loaded over insecure HTTP on this HTTPS page: http://cdn.acme.com/badge.png, http://cdn.acme.com/seal.js
issues.impact: Modern browsers block active mixed content, breaking stylesheets, scripts, and media. Also invalidates page security indicators.
issues.suggested_fix: Update resource URLs in your templates and CSS to use relative protocol ('//') or explicit HTTPS ('https://').

issues.title: Internal Broken Links Found on Page
issues.evidence: 3 broken internal links detected on this page: https://acme-analytics-demo.io/docs/v1-deprecated (HTTP 404), https://acme-analytics-demo.io/api/old (HTTP 404)
issues.impact: Broken internal links create dead ends for visitors, increase bounce rate, and waste search bot crawl capacity.
issues.suggested_fix: Update or remove the broken hyperlinks in this page's content or template.

issues.title: Missing H1 Heading
issues.evidence: No <h1> tag exists in the HTML document.
issues.impact: The H1 tag clarifies the main topic of the page for both users and search bots. Missing H1 hurts semantic structure.
issues.suggested_fix: Add exactly one clear, prominent <h1> heading matching the page's primary intent.

issues.title: Duplicate Page Title Across Multiple URLs
issues.evidence: Shared title 'Acme Analytics Blog | Insights & Trends' appears on 3 pages: https://acme-analytics-demo.io/blog, https://acme-analytics-demo.io/blog/page/2, https://acme-analytics-demo.io/blog/page/3
issues.impact: Identical title tags force pages to compete against each other for rankings (keyword cannibalization) and reduce CTR.
issues.suggested_fix: Craft a unique, specific title tag for each distinct URL highlighting its distinct value (e.g. append 'Page 2').

issues.title: Missing Meta Description
issues.evidence: No <meta name='description'> tag found in document head.
issues.impact: Meta descriptions directly influence organic click-through rates (CTR). Without one, search engines pull arbitrary page text.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an engaging meta description between 120 and 160 characters summarizing the page content with a call to action.

issues.title: Images Missing Alt Attributes
issues.impact: Alt tags provide image context to search engines for Google Image Search and enable accessibility for screen readers.
issues.suggested_fix: Add descriptive, keyword-relevant alt attributes to all content images. Use alt='' only for purely decorative graphics.

issues.title: Redirect Chain Detected
issues.impact: Redirect chains slow down page load times, waste crawler budget, and dilute PageRank transfer.
issues.suggested_fix: Point internal links and the initial redirect directly to the final destination URL.

issues.title: Multiple H1 Headings Detected
issues.evidence: Found 2 H1 headings: 'Simple, Transparent Pricing' and 'Enterprise Custom Plans'
issues.impact: While HTML5 technically allows multiple H1s, best practice is a single H1 to emphasize the primary page focus.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep only one primary H1 for the page title and convert secondary headings to H2 or H3.

issues.title: Relative Canonical URL Used
issues.impact: Google recommends absolute URLs for canonical tags to prevent misinterpretation across protocol or domain variations.
issues.suggested_fix: Change to absolute URL format: https://acme-analytics-demo.io/contact

issues.title: Duplicate Meta Description
issues.evidence: Identical meta description used on 2 pages: 'Join the Acme Analytics team and help build the future of AI analytics.'
issues.impact: Duplicate descriptions provide poor user search snippets and are frequently replaced by Google with arbitrary text.
issues.suggested_fix: Write unique meta descriptions tailored to the specific content and call-to-action of each page.

issues.title: Broken External Link
issues.impact: Outbound broken links degrade user experience and signal outdated or unmaintained web content to search engines.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace with a working resource URL or remove the broken link from your pages.

issues.title: Title Tag Exceeds Recommended Length
issues.evidence: Title length is 78 characters (> 65 chars): 'Customer Case Studies, Customer Testimonials & Enterprise ROI Reports | Acme'
issues.impact: Long titles are truncated with ellipses (...) in Google search engine result pages (SERPs).
issues.suggested_fix: Shorten the title tag to between 50 and 60 characters so it fits on both desktop and mobile SERPs.

issues.title: Heading Hierarchy Levels Skipped
issues.evidence: Headings skip structural levels (sequence: H1 -> H3 -> H4)
issues.impact: Skipping heading tags (e.g. jumping from H1 directly to H3) compromises accessibility for screen readers and semantic clarity.
issues.suggested_fix: Nest headings sequentially: use H2 tags under H1, and H3 tags under H2.

issues.title: Meta Description Is Too Short
issues.evidence: Meta description is only 31 characters: 'Read our privacy terms policy.'
issues.impact: Under-optimized meta descriptions underperform in attracting clicks and conveying context to users.
issues.suggested_fix: Expand the meta description to 120–160 characters to provide a compelling snippet in search results.

issues.title: Missing Character Encoding Declaration
issues.evidence: No character set declaration (<meta charset='utf-8'>) detected.
issues.impact: Browsers and crawlers might misinterpret special characters, hurting readability and content extraction.
issues.suggested_fix: Add <meta charset='UTF-8'> as the first element in the HTML <head>.
